melder.utilities.custom_exceptions.manag.label: managed_spell_exhausted_error
melder.utilities.custom_exceptions.manag.role: Module holding ManagedSpellExhaustedError, the refusal of a managed pool with no place.
responsibilities: exports the error; it imports only MeldExecutionError, so the pool depends on it and not the reverse

melder.utilities.custom_exceptions.manag.label: ManagedSpellExhaustedError
melder.utilities.custom_exceptions.manag.role: MeldExecutionError raised at meld when a managed pool has no place: limited_quantity with every object out, or queue after its timeout.
responsibilities: built only through limited(...) and queue(...), which own the message texts: the spell, the mode, the limit (and the queue timeout printed with :g) and the remedies - release an object through ReleaseManagedSpell, or bind a higher managed_spell_limit or managed_spell_timeout_seconds
raised by ManagedSpellQuantity.reserve before anything is built, the pool's count unchanged; elastic pools never raise it
keeps every MeldExecutionError field (spell_id and spell_name set; node_id, param_name and inner None), so a handler of MeldExecutionError keeps catching it; exported at the package root
